The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Class: one small calm resource marker recognisable by its shape alone, smaller and less saturated than a unit, thick single-colour black outline, simple shapes. It sits directly on the empty transparent background with nothing drawn under it.

layers.text: Subject: two plump fish leaping out of one tiny white water splash in two arcs that cross, one fish heading up to the left and the other up to the right, each with a soft golden-yellow body, a dark blue back and big simple fins; the two fish and the splash are the only things in the image.
Light: the sun is low in the south-west, at the bottom left of the image, so the fish are lit on their left and lower sides and shaded on their right.
